description: Calculates electrical resistance of a wire using the formula R = ρL/A, where R is resistance, ρ is material resistivity, L is length, and A is cross-sectional area. (cost: 1 credit)

area_sq_m.description: number, required, cross-sectional area of the wire, square meters (m²), no default

length_m.description: number, required, length of the wire, meters (m), no default

material.description: string, required, material type (e.g., copper, aluminum, silver, gold), no units, no default

name: wire_resistance
